Your printer tracks you, but this isn't how. This dot system has been around for a while. It just means the documents you print can be traced back to the printer. But, only if LE can get their hands on the printer to compare it. The treasury department (or other law enforcement) can submit dot patterns to manufacturers, and get records of who the printer was sold to by the manufacturer. I know at least one of the major printer manufacturers cooperates with LE without requiring a warrant, because I used to work for them as a tech. However, the manufacturer can only trace to the distributor. The distributor can only trace to the retailer. Unless you bought the program with an extended warranty, or under a "rewards" program that gives your personally identifiable info to the seller, the trail stops there. LE knows which store you bought it from, and likely what city you live in, but that's all the dots will tell them.

If you want to see if your printer has these dots, print an all cyan solid page. The yellow dots will show up as dark spots on the Cyan. The dots are there to track which printer counterfeit bills were printed from. The dots are hard coded into the firmware of the machine. It is possible to use photoshop to add yellow dots to an image, which would make it difficult to identify which dots are part of the "fingerprint," but there aren't really any ways to make the printer not print the dots.

The real method printers and copiers use to track you is by storing your data, usually un-encrypted, on internal hard drives. Many large printers and copiers keep records on the hard drive that show what documents were printed. Manufactures usually sell add-ons to encrypt or shred this data for HIPAA compliance, but those are usually expensive options. For fun times, buy an old copier on Ebay, remove the HD, and look at all the fun info you can get. I once bought a used copier from a lawyer. It had all sorts of stuff on it. Social Security Numbers, Credit Card Numbers (The secretary photocopied credit cards for child support cases so she could submit the payments each month), and testimonials and statements from cases. The lawyer was a friend of mine. I showed him and after he shit himself, I helped him order the kit to keep his new copier from saving that stuff.
